title: The quadrant law: the corner returns at the Catalan times
claim: Obstructed under the frozen criterion: A1 (in the quadrant the corner's return series is C(w^4) over GF(2)) and A2 (C_k^2 returns of length 4k) are not proved. Proved (refereed): Lemma 1, on the v contacts (2a, 2b + 1) A^2 is the walk to the four neighbours with no north step from column 0 (and no south step from the last column when X is bounded); Theorem 2, the reflection in X - Y = -1 through the corner is a symmetry of the walk and mod 2 only returns whose excursions lie on the side X - Y >= 1 and touch Y = 0 (or X = N in the box) survive; Theorem 3, with at most one far wall the corner's return series is R(w^2), R(s) = [(I - sD - s^2 f(P))^-1]_00 over the integers, P the row path, D its lowering part, f(P) = sum_h C_h s^2h (I - sP)^-(2h+1), so A1 is one identity on the half-line, (*1D); Lemma 4, the plain quadrant (no ban) has an even number of returns at every positive length; Proposition 5, C(z) is the loop-end return series of the looped half-line; and the kernel equation s(z + Y)a(z) + s(1/z + Y)a(1/z) = (z + 1/z)Y for the corner's column, which forces a(z) = (1 + zY)(1 + Sigma/z) with Sigma symmetric, and the equivalence of A1 with a doubled identity on the half-line. Computed: A1 below w^4000 (w^8000 in the stress test), A2 for k <= 24, the pairing of the corner's row and column (entry 2k = t0 entry 2k - 1, t0 = s C(s^2), k <= 8), the structure of M^2 and the doubled identity below u^40.
failure_conditions: A time at which the quadrant's corner return count is odd and not of the form 4(2^j - 1), or even at such a time (computed false below w^1200).
A k at which the corner returns of length 4k are not C_k^2 in number (computed false for k <= 12).
remaining_obligations: (*1D) on the half-line: [(I + sD + s^2 f(P))^-1]_00 = C(s^2) over GF(2)
A2 (the integer count C_k^2) by proof
foundation_claim_scope: The square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12, 12) contacts, cut open by a ring of cuts each way (A30, A32, A37, A38), its walk over GF(2), and the same walk with one or both far walls removed. Returns are a contact-level reading, so they do not depend on how the rings are declared beyond which contacts each ring holds (A45).
